$comment: Each budget is a reading plus a margin: 5% for sizes, 10% for counts (M5.7, D69, docs/specs/performance.md#the-budgets). A change that adds weight on purpose raises the budget with its new reading and date, in the same change. Sizes are checked by pnpm budgets after the build, counts by perf.spec.ts: the grove's glade with a box, framed on a 1280 x 900 desktop, orbited 50 degrees, every plant's model drawn.

editor-start.of: zlib's gzip at level 9 of index.html, its module, every chunk that module imports statically, and its stylesheets, each file on its own; re-read at M6.4, whose fighting kit's type files and words the catalog reads at the start, and M6.5, whose record form reads the animator's facts; and M6.6, whose quest form offers a target's choices and whose designer knows the space-map widget; and M6.7, whose Scene inspector's Tags field is in the start's chunks; and M6.8, whose start reads a shop's actor and a merchant's checks together; and M6.9, whose New project lists the two 3D templates and whose guide opens a space's object; and M7.1, whose Scene panel offers New 2D space and loads the 2D view and its toolbar; and M7.2, whose 2D toolbar offers Add → Tilemap… and the Tiles row; and at M7.3, whose room type and building component the catalog lists

scene-view.of: zlib's gzip at level 9 of the SceneView chunk and the chunks it imports statically that the start doesn't: three, the view and its parts; re-read at M6.5, whose figures are drawn as the starter character, copied on bones of their own; and M6.6, whose view bakes a space's map from above; and M6.7, whose inspector tags a space and its objects; and M6.8, whose inspector sets an interact's Holds; and M6.9, 163 bytes larger with what it shares with the start; and M7.1, whose inspector places an object in art pixels in a 2D space; and M7.2, whose inspector writes a tilemap's rows and edges as lines; and at M7.3, with the Rooms row, Add → Building… and the building's strokes

models-view.of: zlib's gzip at level 9 of the modelsView chunk and the chunks it imports statically that the start and the view don't: the loaders and decoders; re-read at M6.5, whose skinned models are copied on their own bones; and at M7.3, unchanged but for the shared chunks' names

walk.of: zlib's gzip at level 9 of runtime/walk.js (M5.8): three, Rapier's compat build with its wasm inline, the Draco and Basis decoders, and the stage, the one file every page loads to walk a space; re-read at M6.5, which carries the starter character, its clips and the mixers; and M6.6, which draws the compass and the markers and works out the map's pins; and M7.1, whose outbox sends a use ahead of the stage's letters; and at M7.3, whose core carries pack format 19's checks

nav.of: zlib's gzip at level 9 of runtime/nav.js (M6.2): Recast and Detour through recast-navigation-js, their wasm inline, loaded beside walk.js only for a space with a navmesh, and by Bake navigation's worker

stage2d.of: zlib's gzip at level 9 of runtime/stage2d.js (M7.1): the 2D stage on a Canvas 2D, its sheets decoded by the browser, the walkers, the clock and the uses' buttons, with none of the schemas; loaded only for a 2D space, in place of walk.js; re-read at M7.2, which draws tilemaps autotiled and walks the walkers along core's routes over the tiles, with about 5% room again; re-read at M7.3, which draws buildings, rooms and ladders and walks the walkers up and down their stairs by core's route, with about 5% room again

precache.of: bytes of every file the service worker precaches, as a device keeps them; walk.js (6.9 MB) since M5.8, nav.js (0.8 MB) since M6.2; re-read at M6.5, with the starter character in walk.js, the editor and Add starter character's chunk; and M6.6, with the compass, the markers, the Map screen and Bake map; and M6.7, with the Tags field and the quests kit's world slots; and M6.8, with containers and merchants in the kits, the Container screen and its template; and M6.9, with the valley hamlet's and the lighthouse's chunks, their models and navmeshes inlined; and M7.1, with stage2d.js, the 2D view and the starter sprites' chunk; and M7.2, with the Tiles row, the tileset's preview and the starter tileset; and M7.3, with the starter rooms, the Rooms row and the building's tools

space-wrecked-web.of: bytes of every file of Space-Wrecked's web export (M4.12), with about 4% room for its content; re-read at M6.3, whose ai kit every export's runtime carries; re-read at M6.6, whose runtime carries the markers' session and the Map screen's widget; re-read at M6.7, whose runtime's quests kit finds slots in the world; re-read at M6.8, whose runtime's kits open containers and keep purses, with about 4% room again; re-read at M6.9, whose runtime's quests kit says whether a quest can start; re-read at M7.1, whose runtime loads stage2d.js for a 2D space; re-read at M7.2, whose runtime reads format 18's tiles and world.sees and world.cover; and at M7.3, whose runtime reads pack format 19

trail-web.of: bytes of every file of the trail's web export (M5.8): walk.js beside the runtime, and the trail's world in the page; re-read at M6.5, whose walk.js carries the starter character; and M6.6, whose walk.js draws the compass and the markers; and M6.7, whose runtime's quests kit finds slots in the world; and M6.8, whose runtime's kits open containers and keep purses; and M6.9, whose runtime's quests kit says whether a quest can start; and M7.1, whose runtime loads stage2d.js for a 2D space; and M7.2, whose runtime reads format 18's tiles and world.sees and world.cover; and at M7.3, whose runtime reads pack format 19

kaldvik-web.of: bytes of every file of Kaldvík's web export (M6.10, D82), proof #2: walk.js and nav.js beside the runtime, and in the page the shore's terrain, its four navmeshes and the starter kit's pieces; about 5% room; re-read at M7.1, whose runtime loads stage2d.js for a 2D space; re-read at M7.2, whose runtime reads format 18's tiles and world.sees and world.cover; and at M7.3, whose runtime reads pack format 19
